cells.gaps: Electronic bid submission was still in pilot training in June 2026 (SLE-003). No source found says e-procurement runs to award or is required of all public bodies, and no figure has been found.
cells.note: NPPA opened an e-GP portal with tender notices in January 2026 (SLE-004) and launched the bid publication module in July 2026 (SLE-002, SLE-005), so tenders are published online; bidding is not yet online.
